senses.definition_en: they shall not pass (expressing determination to defend a position)

examples.english: “The reactionary bloc has failed. There are more Spaniards who want Spain to move forward and so it will continue to be,” shouted a euphoric Pedro Sánchez as the rank and file of the PSOE shouted “They shall not pass!” at the door of their headquarters.
examples.ref: 2023 July 24, Carlos E. Cué, quoting Pedro Sánchez, “La resistencia del PSOE y Sumar frustra la mayoría del PP y Vox y deja abiertas todas las posibilidades”, in El País:
examples.text: “El bloque involucionista ha fracasado. Son más los españoles que quieren que España avance y así va a seguir siendo”, gritó un Pedro Sánchez eufórico mientras las bases del PSOE gritaban “¡No pasarán!” en la puerta de su sede.
examples.translation: “The reactionary bloc has failed. There are more Spaniards who want Spain to move forward and so it will continue to be,” shouted a euphoric Pedro Sánchez as the rank and file of the PSOE shouted “They shall not pass!” at the door of their headquarters.

glosses: they shall not pass (expressing determination to defend a position)
